extractedFacts.wrongfulLockoutCitation: Iowa's enhanced wrongful-lockout remedy (Iowa Code Sec. 562A.26 -- actual damages plus 2 months' rent or 2x actual damages, whichever greater, plus punitive damages up to 2x monthly rent) is part of the Iowa Uniform Residential Landlord and Tenant Act (Ch. 562A) and does not extend to commercial tenancies. No case law confirms whether commercial self-help is available or prohibited in Iowa; no commercial-specific enhancement found.

outcome.description: After a bench trial the district court awarded the tenant $257,216 in damages plus post-judgment interest, using the tenant's damages methodology (unrealized appreciation, rent-versus-mortgage differential, lost principal) but valuing the unit at the $166.73 per square foot the third-party buyers paid rather than the $275 the tenant proposed. No attorney's fees. The Iowa Court of Appeals affirmed (2-1) on August 19, 2026, rejecting the estoppel-by-acquiescence and failure-to-mitigate defenses.

source.caseName: The Law Office of Melvin O. Shaw, P.L.C. v. A & M Development, L.L.C.
source.court: Iowa Court of Appeals (appeal from Iowa District Court for Johnson County)
source.excerptNote: Verbatim from Part I (Facts and Prior Proceedings), the parties' contentions in Part III.A-B, and the undisputed timeline recited in Judge Greer's dissent. The dissent's footnote characterizing A & M's conduct as a breach was also omitted. Extraction whitespace artifacts corrected.
